name: Compose Ports
description: Lists the services in each Docker Compose file at the workspace root (compose*.yml, docker-compose*.yml) with their published ports. Reads the files only; it does not call Docker.

actions.title: Scan compose ports
actions.description: Reads the Compose files at the workspace root and publishes one row per service and port mapping. A service without ports gets one row with empty port columns. Does not start Docker or containers.

only_published.description: Show only services that publish at least one port.
